note: Triennial election of Limavady Rural District Council (23 divisions). Only nine nominations were received, on Friday 28 April 1933, eight of them outgoing councillors; the only new member was Michael M'Closkey for Dungiven. There was no contest, and the outgoing councillors of the other divisions returned to office. The Ballymoney Free Press (11 May 1933, p. 1) prints the new council of twenty-three by division. Filed under 2 June 1933, the polling day in Co. Londonderry (confirmed). Added in the meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026. Printed '(old)'. Returned unopposed.
